content.text: The change adds a single static `CREATE INDEX` DDL string to a `LiteralString`-typed list used to seed a demo schema, plus a corresponding count assertion bump in a test. The schema identifier is passed through `psycopg.sql.Identifier`, and no attacker-influenceable value reaches any sink. No security-relevant code paths (auth, parsing, validation, I/O boundaries, logging of secrets) are touched.
